Prada clothing for men features a selection of tailored suits, jackets and leather jackets, printed shirts, men's sweaters in cashmere and fine yarns with a strong graphic impact, elegant men's wool pants and coats with clean lines, and T-shirts and sweatshirts with a contemporary design.
